mapper.select: SELECT SNAPSHOT_ID AS SNAPSHOT_ID, TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, METRIC_SCOPE_CD AS METRIC_SCOPE_CD, CAPTURED_AT AS CAPTURED_AT, CPU_PCT AS CPU_PCT, MEM_PCT AS MEM_PCT, TPS AS TPS, RESP_P95_MS AS RESP_P95_MS, DB_CONN_PEAK AS DB_CONN_PEAK, REMARK AS REMARK, REG_USER_ID AS REG_USER_ID, REG_DTM AS REG_DTM FROM TB_IF_CAPACITY_PILOT WHERE TARGET_TYPE_CD = #{targetTypeCd} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId} ORDER BY CASE METRIC_SCOPE_CD WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'PEAK' THEN 2 WHEN 'TARGET' THEN 3 WHEN 'N1' THEN 4 WHEN 'DR' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, SNAPSHOT_ID

SELECT SNAPSHOT_ID AS SNAPSHOT_ID, TARGET_TYPE_CD AS TARGET_TYPE_CD, TARGET_ID AS TARGET_ID, METRIC_SCOPE_CD AS METRIC_SCOPE_CD, CAPTURED_AT AS CAPTURED_AT, CPU_PCT AS CPU_PCT, MEM_PCT AS MEM_PCT, TPS AS TPS, RESP_P95_MS AS RESP_P95_MS, DB_CONN_PEAK AS DB_CONN_PEAK, REMARK AS REMARK FROM TB_IF_CAPACITY_PILOT WHERE TARGET_TYPE_CD = #{targetTypeCd} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND METRIC_SCOPE_CD = #{metricScopeCd}
